subject: Procurement process & vendor setup for Redwood (Zenith Retail)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: procurement & vendor setup (Redwood)

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps on procurement: 

- Summary of call: Zenith is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing search and chat experiences across web and mobile. Goal is pilot in Q4 with 2–3 product teams.
- Procurement preference: you mentioned central procurement owns vendor payments; want to confirm PO vs card and expected paper process.
- Required docs: vendor packet, W-9/W-8, banking details for ACH/PO setup, and any internal vendor portal form (if applicable).
- Marketplace: you asked if we support marketplace purchases (AWS/GCP). We do — can surface pricing via marketplaces which sometimes speeds procurement.

Could you confirm:
1) Procurement contact and preferred payment method (PO net-30, PO net-45, or card)?
2) Estimated timeline for vendor setup (1–3 weeks vs 3–6 weeks)?
3) Any specific vendor portal link we should fill out?

I attached a blank vendor_setup_packet.pdf and a standard Redwood W-9 for your finance team to review. If easier, we can loop in our finance ops to complete exportable vendor forms or talk to your vendor portal admin.

Next steps: once you confirm payment method and timeline, I can share a commercial MSA and draft SOW and loop in Marissa to help with procurement intake.

Thanks — appreciate the time today.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

Attachment: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (fillable vendor information), W-9_redwood.pdf

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@zenithretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Zenith Procurement <procurement@zenithretail.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement & vendor setup (Redwood)

Thanks Dylan — great call. Short answers below and a couple of asks for you/your ops team.

- Payment method: Procurement prefers PO (Net 45) for new vendors; for pilots they sometimes allow central purchasing card to expedite, but PO is default.
- Timeline: Vendor setup typically 2–4 weeks once we receive all docs and vendor portal entry is submitted. Longer if banking verification is needed.
- Vendor portal: We use Coupa. I will forward the vendor portal invite to the email on file, but we usually need the completed vendor packet and a W-9 (or W-8 for foreign entities).

Can you please: 
1) Fill out the attached vendor_setup_packet.pdf with Redwood's banking details and remit-to address?
2) Provide a signed W-9 (we need the EIN details on file) — procurement requires an original PDF with signature.
3) Confirm whether Redwood can accept PO terms (Net 45) for the pilot and provide a point of contact for invoice routing.

Also — we are evaluating whether to buy through AWS Marketplace for procurement ease. Can your team confirm if Redwood can issue invoices via AWS Marketplace and whether list pricing vs negotiated pricing is supported there?

Looping procurement on this thread.

Best,
Samantha Li
Director, Product Operations
Zenith Retail
procurement@zenithretail.com
